stories.title: Define trial phase UI contract
stories.description: Define frontend data contract for trial phase display including phase label (I/II/III/IV), plain-language explanation, and score contribution field. Ensure compatibility with MessageBubble rendering pipeline.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx: rendering pipeline requires structured markdown-compatible content. Backend dependency defined in feature.

stories.title: Implement phase interpretation logic
stories.description: Implement frontend logic to map raw phase values (I/II/III/IV) into consumer-friendly explanations and normalized score contribution display.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing phase interpretation logic in frontend; required to translate backend phase into user-understandable format per feature description.

stories.title: Render phase in clinical trial scorecard UI
stories.description: Integrate phase display into MessageBubble-based scorecard UI including formatted phase label, explanation text, and contribution to overall score.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx: primary UI rendering component for chat responses; feature explicitly states this is the rendering pipeline.

stories.title: End-to-end validation and UI tests for phase display
stories.description: Create tests validating correct rendering of trial phase, explanation accuracy, and score contribution visibility within chat UI.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx and MessageBubble.tsx: existing UI components require validation; GAP: no current tests for clinical trial phase display.
